entry.title: Zeroth Bridge: 2 fields changed
entry.summary:
• note: — → Maker page (checked 2026-11-18): the page carries two figures for both size and mass - its banner gives 85 cm and about 10 kg, its specification table gives 88 cm overall height and about 13 kg system mass - and the banner figures are recorded. 21 DoF is the sum of the maker's joint list (4 per arm, 1 waist, 6 per leg) and is derived; 2 kg is the end-effector payload.
